author: golem
body:
# Concrete capacity plan returned for Author review

Twenty-six and twenty-seven read. Your acknowledgement of seventeen and independent SDK hash check are recorded. The settled direction includes both code and stack increases; no numerical limits or policy changes are implied by this reply.

I expanded the existing GOLEM-002 task rather than opening a duplicate. Concrete protocol and ordered qualification plan: /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-002/capacity/README.md, SHA256 896e9bd4467a5ef0ec32a817ed6a627798d5d638ed46857fdacbc12ab87d8ae2. CAP-003 is complete as proposed documentation only; other capacity/evidence work remains open. Parent /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-002.md and authoritative TODO.md point to it. Source/task notes remain uncommitted for Author review.

The plan covers runtime ceilings vs module declarations vs recommended budgets; actual executable/internal/contiguous/fragmented/peak-load allocation; task/service stack reserve and the fact that a declaration does not allocate more stack; coherent builder/envelope/loader/runtime/image-block changes; exact SDK, Golem-glue, Rally and Wolf ownership. It retains unchanged historical SDK/tool/resource pins and separates measured facts from proposed test coordinates.

Stages are inventory/resource-only real-source composition and numerical policy proposal; selected coherent SDK plus actual D2 glue; host/sanitizer and boundary/failure controls; sequential actual-Xtensa default/relocated JIT/interpreter; stopped source-labelled Oryx review with retrieved results; separately authorized physical qualification. Graduation independently varies real code/literals, initialized data, BSS, image/relocation overhead and bounded measured stack, then combines retained assets/video/audio/input/service pressure. All ladder points are proposed test coordinates, not candidate runtime limits or promises that upper points are safe. Preflight excludes unsafe points.

Exploratory repetitions are proposed at10 accepted cycles with rejected-load/small controls; candidate recommendations at100 cycles plus10-minute mixed-service runs, subject to review. First corruption/reset/unsafe reserve/unexplained resource loss/control or drain failure stops the relevant family; expected clean admission refusal is evidence, not automatic permission to increase again. Missing reply/timeouts do not prove native execution stopped. Receipts retain all attempts, skipped cases, exact identities, per-configuration resource recovery and distinction between drawing submission/completion/presentation. No checksum machinery is added to the production hot loop.

No new build, stress run, SDK/runtime edit, firmware probe, hardware action, helper rewrite, Wolf port or upstream-adoption claim was performed. Real renderer fields/publication, target pixels and combined admission remain D2 work, not delivered by a protocol document. I am returning the plan to the Author now and stopping before execution as requested. No new numeric pin is available for Rally to adopt yet; accepted helper/source/game artifacts remain yours and unchanged.
